idea.title: Invoice Tone Ladder
idea.one_liner: Auto-generating escalating payment reminder emails based on days-overdue via Stripe/QuickBooks webhooks
idea.problem: freelancers spend 4-6 hours/month manually escalating overdue-payment emails, existing tools only send flat reminders
idea.solution: webhook listener + 3-tier template engine (polite→firm→final) + scheduler + dashboard, 2-person team 4 days
